spans.view: with a round café table between them and two wooden chairs

beats.text: Pax and Polly sit at the café table, both sipping their iced drinks through straws with their eyes closed
Pax opens his eyes and glances sideways at Polly while still sipping, as she keeps drinking
Pax sets his cup down on the table and sits up watching Polly, who keeps sipping with her eyes closed
Pax turns toward Polly and taps her arm with his flipper while she sips and then opens her eyes
Polly turns toward Pax with her straw still in her beak while he looks back at her with a frown
Pax turns to face forward and raises his flipper, flexing it like a bicep
Pax holds the flex and glances at Polly while she stares at his raised flipper
Polly reaches out and squeezes Pax's flexed flipper with her own while he watches her
Polly pulls her flipper back and turns to face forward
Polly sips her drink and glances wide-eyed at Pax while he sits back and looks at her
Pax lifts his cup and sips with his eyes closed while Polly stares ahead with blushing cheeks

spans.notes: one continuous locked shot, no cuts: compare f0/f219 table, pedestal and Pax's chair edges black; only Polly's chair shifts with her (it is why motion on the table band y 0.64-0.80 reads tx +70 px at cc 0.95 from f90 while the table itself does not move; rows f6-84 read 1.000 at cc 0.99-1.00). Pax's cup carries a green round logo parodying a coffee-chain siren (a crowned white penguin, tiny text under it): treated as an invented Pudgy-world logo like Huddlebucks, not a real brand and not a lead depiction; flagged. No caption or watermark (top third and bottom fifth plain throughout). The whole skit carries 4 px pure-black columns at the left and right picture edges (export pillarbox, ~1.8 px after prep's 480-wide scale); kept as other curators kept PP-Favor and PP-BFPockets with the same bars, flagged for a global ruling.
